complex_ideas.idea: Data tiers as architecture-as-law (what may leave the machine)
Model lanes: local vs specialist cloud

The goal is to create a single, comprehensive dashboard that maps the entire journey of an idea—from its birth (origin) through processing (models used) to its final state (gleaned artifacts), all while tracking time and resource cost.
By building local tools (like using Ollama for Llama models), the system can maintain control over its resources, ensuring it doesn't run out of 'quota' from external providers like Google or OpenAI.

The core technical challenge is creating one central data point (`/api/idea-flow`) that synthesizes usage metrics (tokens, time, model type) to prove the system's self-sufficiency and resource management capabilities.
